name: Telemetry Collector for Cisco NX-OS
what_it_is: A Docker-based TIG stack (Telegraf, InfluxDB, Grafana) that automates deployment of a telemetry collection pipeline for Cisco NX-OS devices. It supports both dial-out (device-initiated gRPC/GPB) and dial-in (gNMI) collection modes with pre-built Grafana dashboards.
protocols: gRPC with GPB encoding (dial-out, TCP port 57000)
measurement: System capacity and utilization via ICAM telemetry
configuration: GNMI_USER environment variable (requires network-operator role minimum)
TLS optional for dial-out (disabled by default, toggled via config)
Certificate CN must match configured value (default: telegraf)
modes: Dial-out: device-initiated gRPC/GPB streaming to Telegraf on port 57000
constraints: NX-OS versions before 10.1(1) support only SAMPLE or ON_CHANGE per gNMI subscription, not both simultaneously — requires separate Telegraf instances
MacOS requires GNU sed; BSD sed (default on macOS) is incompatible with setup scripts
Only supports Cisco NX-OS devices — no multi-vendor telemetry support
No built-in data retention or cleanup policies documented
notable_absences: No fault injection or chaos engineering capabilities
No support for non-Cisco (non-NX-OS) vendor telemetry formats
No custom metric definition interface beyond Telegraf plugin configuration
docker-compose.yml not found on main branch (may reside on master or alternate branch)
